profile.title: User Profile
profile.delete_account_confirm_body: This action cannot be undone. This will permanently delete your account and remove your data from our servers.
profile.delete_account_confirm_warning: All your decks, cards, and progress will be lost.

profile.card_style_desc: Display questions and answers inside a styled card. When off, content is shown inline.
profile.flip_animation_desc: Show 3D flip animation when revealing a card
profile.visual_card_size_desc: How wide image-occlusion cards render during study. Independent of window zoom (Ctrl + / − / 0) — that scales everything.
profile.background_image_desc: Set a custom background image for the app. For best results, use an image at least 1920×1080 pixels.
profile.notifications_desc: Get notified when you have cards due for review
profile.daily_limits_desc: Limit how many new and review cards you see each day. Turn off to let the scheduling algorithm decide. Cards you're currently learning are always shown.
profile.study_timer_desc: Configure timing behavior during study sessions
profile.max_answer_seconds_desc: Time limit per card for statistics and auto-advance. Range: 10–300.
profile.show_timer_desc: Display a timer on the study screen
profile.auto_advance_desc: When the timer expires: auto-flip if question is showing, or grade 'Again' if answer is showing
profile.import_anki_desc: Import your decks (.apkg files) including cards, media, and scheduling data.
profile.export_collection_desc: Export all your decks, cards, and review history as a .spkg file. Includes media.
profile.replay_tour_desc: Walk through the welcome slides and feature tour again.

dashboard-hero.title: Your day at a glance
dashboard-hero.body: Cards due, today's activity, your streak, and exam countdown — all in one row.

dashboard-intelligence.title: SEKEL Intelligence
dashboard-intelligence.body: Tracks your accuracy per exam system. Unlocks after 10 reviews per system so you can see where you're strong and where you're weak.

dashboard-plan-overview.title: Your plan
dashboard-plan-overview.body: Daily targets adjust as you go. Miss a day? SEKEL rebalances so you stay on track.

dashboard-deck-health.title: Your deck health
dashboard-deck-health.body: A per-deck snapshot — total cards, classified, and due — for everything you're studying.

dashboard-exam-readiness.title: Exam readiness
dashboard-exam-readiness.body: Each system from your exam blueprint with its weight, retention, and current status.

dashboard-quick-actions.title: Quick actions
dashboard-quick-actions.body: Jump straight to today's session, generate cards from a document, or open your plan.

documents-upload.title: Generate flashcards
documents-upload.body: Drop a PDF, video, or notes. SEKEL turns them into smart cards — high-yield first.

plan-targets.title: Plans
plan-targets.body: Set daily targets, watch coverage roll up, and rebalance when life happens.

plan-activity.title: Plan activity
plan-activity.body: Today, this week, or since the plan started — your rating breakdown shows how reviews are landing.

plan-weekly-workload.title: Weekly workload
plan-weekly-workload.body: Forecasted reviews and study time per week so you can see what's coming and pace yourself.

plan-system-coverage.title: System coverage
plan-system-coverage.body: How much of each exam system your plan covers — quick read on where you're stronger or thinner.

decks.title: Your decks
decks.body: All your decks live here. Tap any deck to study or browse cards.

image-occlusion.title: Visual cards
image-occlusion.body: For anatomy, diagrams, and pathways. Cover what matters, reveal as you study.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.body: Cards you start but don't finish wait here — pick them back up anytime.

statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.body: Card maturity, retention, missed topics, and review heatmaps — your progress at a glance.

profile-info.title: Profile
profile-info.body: Name, avatar, exam, and target date — the basics SEKEL uses to tune your plan.

profile-preferences.title: Preferences
profile-preferences.body: Theme, notifications, intelligence on/off, and daily limits live here.

profile-study.title: Study
profile-study.body: Your exam, target date, and daily study targets — SEKEL uses these to shape your plan.

profile-backup.title: Backup
profile-backup.body: Your decks sync, and you can export anytime for safekeeping or migration.

profile-account.title: Account
profile-account.body: Password, data import/export, feedback, and the Replay tour button live here.
